notes: Primary research article (J. Phys. Chem. B 2006). Sorbents are zeolite-templated carbons: the zeolite was removed by HF washing and HCl reflux, with TGA residue 'typically lower than 3%' (main p. 2, Section 2.1), and N content is 5-8 wt% (Table 1), so carbon is the majority component (templated / N-doped carbon). Uptake measured gravimetrically (IGA, 0-20 bar, -196 °C, buoyancy-corrected; Figure 8, Table 1) and volumetrically (ASAP 2020, 0-1.1 bar, -196 °C; Figure 10) for CX850 and CY800. No retraction notice in the PDF; record is_retracted false. No statement that the uptake values were published before. Zeolite 13X and Y templates have surface areas in Table 1 but no H2 uptake reported.
